name: Low-Carb Cheesy Ground Beef & Broccoli Skillet
why: Verified from recipe card: 430 cal, 28g protein, 8g carbs per serving - squarely in the 400-650 cal / <=35g carb band with strong protein-to-cal. Structurally low-carb: ground beef + broccoli + cheese/cream, no rice/pasta/potato base. Distinct from catalog's rice-based cheesy-beef-broccoli-bowls (this is a no-rice keto skillet). Every ingredient maps to the Omaha board (ground-beef-8020, broccoli, onions, garlic, paprika, black-pepper, salt, red-pepper-flakes, olive-oil, shredded-cheese covers cheddar+mozzarella, heavy-cream, cream-cheese, dijon-mustard). Weigh-and-divide scalable to 14 in a large skillet.
